Mona Hinton is half of the jazz world’s most beloved couple. She has helped direct the marvelous career of her husband Milt Hinton, and acted as a business advisor to Count Basie as well as music contractor for Lena Horne, Quincy Jones and Sammy Davis. Along the way, Mona received a Master’s Degree in Education, while serving as a support system for many struggling jazz artists in New York City.

Mona was interviewed by Milt Fillius and Dr. Michael Woods in Scottsdale, Arizona on March 4, 1995. At the festival she received the distinction as the first non-performer to ever be chosen as the festival’s “Guest of Honor.”
